description: Something the user did in an app, a few kept before an error (its breadcrumbs): what was on screen and the part used, by their schema/ui names.

at.description: When, in seconds since the epoch.

action.description: What was done: a button or row clicked (or activated from the keyboard), a menu's item picked, or a screen opened (a tab, a page, a dialog, a side panel's page).

screen.description: The schema/ui entity it was on ("Telemetry.dialog"), null where it has none.

part.description: The entity's part used, by its name there ("Collect Telemetry"), null where it isn't one of its parts.

widget.description: What was used where it isn't a part schema/ui names: its copy key, else its icon's name, else its kind of widget.
